target: For every finite d-dimensional simplicial complex K which is doubly Cohen-Macaulay over a fixed field k, d>=1, can the minimal d-cycle pieces S_i in Nevo Theorem 7 (OWR17/2005, printed961; Theorem3.4 in arXiv:math/0505334v2) be chosen to be k-homology spheres, with K equal to their union and the specified ordered facet-overlap/reorderability? This is OWR Problem8, and arXiv Problem3.7. Distinguish a negative counterexample to mere sphere covering (enough for full negative resolution) from stronger CM intersections question.
independence: Original target source texts read first. Candidate proof, old audits, root verdicts, other new priority agents not read before sealing. No subagents or outreach.
success_test: Find prior recorded explicit theorem/counterexample or explicit full consequence matching the full target; distinguish tools from new deductions, partial scopes, field and dimension, covering versus ordered decomposition. A bounded no-find is not a firstness or global openness certificate.
mechanisms: Nevo original version/publication comparison and exact Problem3.7 citing works
Later Nevo/Oba cycle-complex decompositions, Lefschetz and g-vector results
Balanced/local-CM/negative sphere-cover and hyperbolic building examples
Books/surveys and forward citations for independently stated problem status
search_budget: 30-45 targeted query strings plus adaptive primary-source followups, through current date 2026-10-17 (Pacific).
evidence_rules: Primary technical bodies inspected; snippets only discovery.
All third-party PDFs, text, extracts, renders and raw returns remain under private/.
Public files limited to precreated allowlist.
Report read scope and access gaps; record exact versions/passages and full mapping.
